criteria.requirement: Repair Console._collect_renderables single-Text collection: retain the Text own justify/overflow/no_wrap/style/spans through a copy rather than recreating it from the separator template. Current print end replaces the copy end, explicit print justify/overflow/no_wrap still have their existing priority, and the caller Text never mutates. Preserve multiple-item separator-join policy, ordinary strings, non-text renderables/Group/Panel and style wrapping. Verify actual Console output for centered/right-aligned Unicode and ellipsis/no-wrap, not only intermediary attributes; do not change default multi-Text conflict semantics in this delivery.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
